services.name: Kayak & SUP Tours
services.desc: Although our guided tours are what we are known for and by far our most popular adventures, we also offer self-guided tours with our rentals from our Lido Key location. We recommend these only for paddlers with some experience. If it is your first time paddling the area, we encourage you to take a guided tour to help get your bearings, and then come back for a rental! With our self-guided rentals, you get up to 3 hours on the water and can paddle at your own pace. You can even stop off for a picnic or swimming break on the nearby beach! blurb: Almost Heaven Kayak Adventures is the original eco-tour in the greater Sarasota area and has been in business for well over a decade. We offer a wide variety of guided kayak tours in many different types of water in Southwest Florida’s coastal and inland habitats for paddlers of all ages, skill levels, physical conditions, and sizes!
